vendor.name: Image-Line
vendor.description: Developer of FL Studio and its native plug-in catalog.

products.name: 3x OSC
products.summary: A compact three-oscillator subtractive synthesizer.
poor_fit_when: complex modulation or sample playback is required

products.name: Audio Clip Generator
products.summary: The FL Studio channel type that holds and plays recorded audio clips.

products.name: Autogun
products.summary: A preset-oriented additive synthesizer derived from Ogun technology.

products.name: Automation Clip Generator
products.summary: The FL Studio generator that stores automation shapes used in the Playlist.

products.name: BassDrum
products.summary: A modeled percussion instrument focused on bass-drum design.

products.name: BeepMap
products.summary: An image-driven synthesizer that converts bitmap information into sound.

products.name: BooBass
products.summary: A simple simulated bass-guitar instrument.

products.name: Buzz Generator Adapter
products.summary: An adapter for hosting compatible Buzz instruments inside FL Studio.
limitations: It is a host adapter rather than a sound source by itself.
Not included beyond FL Studio 11; it was 32-bit only.

products.name: Channel Sampler
products.summary: FL Studio's basic single-sample playback channel.

products.name: Channel Settings
products.summary: The native controls that configure an FL Studio channel.

products.name: Control Surface
products.summary: A configurable panel for building internal controls and linking parameters.

products.name: Dashboard
products.summary: A configurable control panel for internal or external MIDI targets.
limitations: Legacy module retained for old projects; Image-Line recommends Control Surface for new projects.

products.name: DirectWave Full
products.summary: A full sampler for multisampled instruments, mapping, editing, layering, and modulation.
poor_fit_when: a synthesizer rather than sample playback is required

products.name: DirectWave Player
products.summary: The playback-focused DirectWave edition for mapped sample instruments.
limitations: Advanced editing and mapping belong to DirectWave Full.

products.name: Distructor
products.summary: A modular multi-model distortion and effects processor.

products.name: Drumaxx
products.summary: A modeled percussion instrument for synthesizing a complete drum kit.

products.name: Drumpad
products.summary: A modeled percussion pad designed for synthesized drum sounds.

products.name: Edison
products.summary: An integrated audio recorder and wave editor with cleanup, analysis, and region tools.
poor_fit_when: non-destructive real-time processing is required

major_modules.name: Recorder
major_modules.description: Captures audio routed through its mixer slot.

major_modules.name: Wave editor
major_modules.description: Edits selections, regions, fades, and sample properties.

major_modules.name: Analysis and cleanup
major_modules.description: Provides spectral, denoise, and preparation tools.

limitations: Many editor actions are not exposed through PostFader's current FL bridge.

products.name: Effector (12 FX)
products.summary: A performance-focused processor that switches among twelve delay, filter, distortion, modulation, and reverb effects.

products.name: Emphasis
products.summary: A multi-stage mastering processor built around compression and limiting.
poor_fit_when: transparent single-purpose control is preferable to a multi-stage chain

products.name: Emphasizer
products.summary: A single-band multi-stage processor derived from Emphasis, combining clean limiting with saturating hard and soft clipping stages.

products.name: EQUO
products.summary: A graphic equalizer for broad spectral shaping and animated curves.

products.name: FL Keys
products.summary: A compact sampled keyboard instrument focused on piano-style sounds.

products.name: FL Slayer
products.summary: A simulated electric-guitar instrument.
limitations: Deprecated by Image-Line and retained for legacy-project compatibility.

products.name: FL Studio Mobile Rack + FX
products.summary: A rack that hosts FL Studio Mobile instruments and effects in desktop FL Studio.

products.name: FLEX
products.summary: A preset-centered instrument with macro controls and downloadable sound libraries.
problems_solved: fast access to production-ready instrument sounds
appropriate_for: players who prefer curated presets over deep synthesis
poor_fit_when: full oscillator-level programming is required

products.name: Fruity Pad Controller (FPC)
products.summary: A multi-pad drum sampler with layered samples and per-pad controls.
poor_fit_when: synthesized percussion rather than samples is required

products.name: Frequency Shifter
products.summary: A frequency shifter for metallic, dissonant, and modulated timbres.
poor_fit_when: musical interval transposition is required instead of fixed frequency shifting

products.name: Frequency Splitter
products.summary: A crossover utility that separates audio into two or three frequency bands for independent routing.

products.name: Fruity Kick
products.summary: A dedicated synthesized kick-drum instrument.

products.name: Fruity 7 Band EQ
products.summary: A seven-band equalizer with fixed center frequencies.
poor_fit_when: surgical frequency or bandwidth control is required

products.name: Fruity Balance
products.summary: A lightweight gain and stereo-position control for a mixer chain.

products.name: Fruity Bass Boost
products.summary: A focused low-frequency boost effect.
common_sources: full mixes needing reviewed low-frequency emphasis
poor_fit_when: subtractive cleanup or precise multi-band EQ is needed

products.name: Fruity Big Clock
products.summary: A large display for project bar, beat, or time position.

products.name: Fruity Blood Overdrive
products.summary: An overdrive effect originally oriented toward distorted guitar tones.

products.name: Fruity Center
products.summary: A utility for removing DC offset from an audio signal.

products.name: Fruity Chorus
products.summary: A chorus effect that layers modulated detuned copies for depth and width.

products.name: Fruity Compressor
products.summary: A conventional single-band compressor with threshold, ratio, timing, and gain controls.
poor_fit_when: multiband or limiter behavior is required
threshold and timing cannot be judged from signal evidence

major_modules.name: Level detector
major_modules.description: Threshold and ratio determine gain reduction.

major_modules.name: Attack and release
major_modules.description: Timing controls shape transient response and recovery.

limitations: PostFader cannot hear gain reduction from FL's live output.

products.name: Fruity Convolver
products.summary: A convolution processor for impulse-response spaces and preset-based linear-phase filtering.
poor_fit_when: low latency or freely adjustable algorithmic decay is the priority
limitations: Impulse-response selection and loading are not exposed by PostFader's current bridge.

products.name: Fruity Dance
products.summary: A synchronized FL Chan visual display rather than an audio processor.

products.name: Fruity dB Meter
products.summary: A basic decibel-level display for a mixer signal.

products.name: Fruity Delay
products.summary: A basic echo and feedback delay effect.

products.name: Fruity Delay 2
products.summary: An echo effect with filtering in the delay path.

products.name: Fruity Delay 3
products.summary: A tempo-aware stereo delay with filtering, modulation, saturation, and feedback shaping.
poor_fit_when: a natural reverberant space is required
unbounded feedback would be unsafe
limitations: A bundled adapter describes selected controls but does not prove every loaded version or parameter.

products.name: Fruity Delay Bank
products.summary: A multi-bank delay for layered echoes and filtered feedback paths.

products.name: Fruity DrumSynth Live
products.summary: A multi-voice synthesized percussion instrument.

products.name: Fruity DX10
products.summary: A compact FM synthesizer.

products.name: Fruity Envelope Controller
products.summary: A playable envelope source for linking and automating other parameters.

products.name: Fruity Fast Dist
products.summary: A lightweight distortion effect for quick nonlinear coloration.

products.name: Fruity Fast LP
products.summary: A simple low-pass filter for reducing high-frequency content.

products.name: Fruity Filter
products.summary: A compact resonant filter effect.

products.name: Fruity Flanger
products.summary: A pronounced modulated comb-filter effect.

products.name: Fruity Flangus
products.summary: An expanded flanger with additional modulation control.

products.name: Fruity Formula Controller
products.summary: A control source that evaluates a user-defined mathematical formula.

products.name: Fruity Free Filter
products.summary: A variable-state filter for straightforward frequency shaping.

products.name: Fruity Granulizer
products.summary: A sample-based granular synthesizer for clouds, textures, and transformed playback.
poor_fit_when: transparent unchanged sample playback is the goal

products.name: Fruity HTML NoteBook
products.summary: A playback-synchronized project notebook that can display HTML-formatted notes.

products.name: Fruity Keyboard Controller
products.summary: A controller source that maps played notes and velocity to linked parameters.

products.name: Fruity Limiter
products.summary: A single-band limiter, compressor, gate, and level-maximizing dynamics processor.
poor_fit_when: multiband control is required
true-peak or audible-result proof is required without a new bounce

major_modules.name: Limiter
major_modules.description: Constrains peaks with ceiling, gain, attack, release, and sustain behavior.

major_modules.name: Compressor
major_modules.description: Provides threshold, ratio, knee, timing, and sidechain-oriented dynamics control.

limitations: Live FL sample peaks are not proof of exported true-peak headroom.
Representative compatibility evidence is read-only and does not validate every control.

products.name: Fruity Love Philter
products.summary: An advanced multi-bank filter with envelopes and rhythmic control.

products.name: Fruity LSD
products.summary: A Windows-only MIDI interface that uses MIDI Out to drive the computer's DirectMusic/DLS synthesizer.
limitations: Windows only; it depends on the operating system's DirectMusic/DLS synthesizer rather than an FL-native sound engine.

products.name: Fruity Multiband Compressor
products.summary: A three-band compressor for independent low-, mid-, and high-frequency dynamics control.
poor_fit_when: a single-band compressor is sufficient or crossover interaction is undesirable

products.name: Fruity Mute 2
products.summary: An automatable signal-muting utility.

products.name: Fruity NoteBook
products.summary: A playback-synchronized text notebook stored with the project.

products.name: Fruity PanOMatic
products.summary: An LFO-driven pan and volume modulation effect.

products.name: Fruity Parametric EQ
products.summary: A parametric equalizer with controllable band frequency, width, and gain.

products.name: Fruity Parametric EQ2
products.summary: A seven-band parametric equalizer with filter-shape choices and an integrated spectrum display.
poor_fit_when: dynamic EQ is required
a curve is being guessed without source or bounce evidence

major_modules.name: Seven filter bands
major_modules.description: Each band exposes frequency, gain, width, and filter type.

major_modules.name: Spectrum display
major_modules.description: Visualizes signal energy behind the EQ curve.

limitations: Its bundled control adapter covers selected parameter roles and does not certify every loaded build or audible outcome.

products.name: Fruity Peak Controller
products.summary: A controller that derives automation from input level and an LFO.

products.name: Fruity Phase Inverter
products.summary: A polarity-inversion utility for correcting or testing phase relationships.

products.name: Fruity Phaser
products.summary: A swept phase-cancellation effect for moving notches and resonant color.

products.name: Fruity Reeverb
products.summary: An early FL Studio algorithmic reverb for simulated acoustic space.
limitations: Legacy first-generation reverb; Image-Line recommends Fruity Reeverb 2.

products.name: Fruity Reeverb 2
products.summary: An algorithmic reverb with room, decay, damping, diffusion, and wet/dry shaping.
problems_solved: placing sources in a shared space
creating short rooms or longer tails
poor_fit_when: a captured convolution space is required
long tails would mask articulation
limitations: The adapter covers selected roles only; PostFader cannot hear the tail or prove the artistic result.

products.name: Fruity Scratcher
products.summary: A turntable-style scratching and playback-manipulation effect.

products.name: Fruity Send
products.summary: A mixer-chain utility that taps audio at a chosen point and routes it to a send track.

products.name: Fruity Slicer
products.summary: A sample slicer for triggering and rearranging regions, especially drum loops.

products.name: Fruity Slicer 2
products.summary: A newer sample-slicing instrument for region-based loop playback and rearrangement.

products.name: Fruity Soft Clipper
products.summary: A simple soft-clipping peak shaper.
poor_fit_when: transparent limiting or exact true-peak compliance is required

products.name: SoundFont Player
products.summary: A player for instruments stored in SoundFont banks.

products.name: Fruity Spectroman
products.summary: A compact spectral sonograph display.

products.name: Fruity Squeeze
products.summary: A bit-reduction and sample-skipping effect for digital degradation.

products.name: Fruity Stereo Enhancer
products.summary: A stereo-position and width enhancement effect.
poor_fit_when: mono compatibility has not been checked

products.name: Fruity Stereo Shaper
products.summary: A stereo matrix processor for channel, phase, and mid-side relationships.
poor_fit_when: the result cannot be checked in mono

products.name: Fruity Vibrator
products.summary: A control generator for supported force-feedback devices.
limitations: Removed from the FL Studio installer in version 12.5; available only through a separate legacy installer.

products.name: Fruity Video Player
products.summary: A video player synchronized with an FL Studio project.
limitations: It is a visual synchronization tool, not an audio generator.

products.name: Fruity Vocoder
products.summary: A filter-bank vocoder that transfers spectral movement from a modulator to a carrier.

products.name: Fruity WaveShaper
products.summary: A user-drawn transfer-curve distortion and saturation effect.
poor_fit_when: transparent processing is required

products.name: Fruity Wrapper
products.summary: FL Studio's host wrapper for compatible external instrument and effect formats.
limitations: The wrapper does not establish ownership, installation, or compatibility of any particular hosted product.

products.name: Fruity X-Y Controller
products.summary: A two-axis controller for linking and moving two parameters together.

products.name: GMS
products.summary: A compact synthesizer using frequency and ring modulation techniques.

products.name: Gross Beat
products.summary: A tempo-synchronized time and volume envelope processor for gating, stutter, scratch, and rearrangement effects.
poor_fit_when: transparent timing correction is required
limitations: PostFader does not fabricate audible validation of time effects.

products.name: Hardcore (11 Guitar FX)
products.summary: A guitar-oriented rack combining eleven modeled pedals, dynamics, EQ, modulation, delay, and reverb.

products.name: Harmless
products.summary: An additive synthesizer presented through a subtractive-style workflow.

products.name: Harmor
products.summary: A deep additive synthesizer with image synthesis, sample resynthesis, filters, effects, and extensive modulation.
poor_fit_when: fast sample playback or a minimal subtractive workflow is preferable

major_modules.name: Image and audio resynthesis
major_modules.description: Transforms images or analyzed samples into spectral material.

major_modules.name: Modulation and effects
major_modules.description: Shapes articulation, filtering, unison, and post-processing.

products.name: Hyper Chorus
products.summary: An extreme multi-voice chorus for dense modulation effects.

products.name: Kepler
products.summary: A native emulation of a vintage analog-style synthesizer.

products.name: Kepler Exo
products.summary: An expanded reimagining of Kepler's vintage-synth concept.

products.name: Layer Channel
products.summary: A Channel Rack controller that triggers multiple child channels together.

products.name: Low Lifter
products.summary: A low-frequency enhancement processor.

products.name: LuxeVerb
products.summary: An advanced algorithmic reverb for realistic rooms, long spaces, modulation, and creative feedback textures.
poor_fit_when: a captured convolution response is specifically required

products.name: Maximus
products.summary: A multiband compressor, limiter, saturator, and maximizer with separate low, mid, high, and master stages.
appropriate_for: complex dynamics that justify crossover bands
poor_fit_when: a transparent single-band compressor is sufficient
settings cannot be verified with a fresh bounce
limitations: Atlas product knowledge does not prove control mappings or a mastered result.

products.name: MIDI Out
products.summary: A Channel Rack controller for sending notes and controls to MIDI hardware or hosted instruments.

products.name: MiniSynth
products.summary: A compact subtractive synthesizer adapted from FL Studio Mobile.

products.name: Morphine
products.summary: An additive synthesizer designed for resynthesis and morphing between spectral states.

products.name: Multiband Delay
products.summary: A creative effect that applies independent delay behavior to frequency bands.

products.name: Newtime
products.summary: An audio editor for timing correction, warping, and tempo alignment.
poor_fit_when: real-time delay or stutter processing is required
limitations: Its editor operations are not exposed through PostFader's current bridge.

products.name: Newtone
products.summary: An audio editor for pitch correction, timing adjustment, and note-level vocal or melodic editing.
poor_fit_when: polyphonic pitch editing is required
limitations: Its editor operations are not exposed through PostFader's current bridge.

products.name: Ogun
products.summary: An additive synthesizer optimized for metallic and percussive timbres.

products.name: Patcher
products.summary: A modular environment for chaining instruments, effects, controllers, and custom interfaces.
appropriate_for: routing beyond a single slot chain
poor_fit_when: a single simple processor is sufficient

major_modules.name: Map view
major_modules.description: Connects audio, event, and parameter links between modules.

major_modules.name: Surface view
major_modules.description: Builds a custom front panel and macros.

limitations: PostFader cannot insert or wire plug-ins inside Patcher through the current FL API.

products.name: Pitch Shifter
products.summary: A real-time effect for shifting input pitch and formant.

products.name: Pitcher
products.summary: A real-time monophonic pitch-correction and harmony effect.
poor_fit_when: polyphonic correction or offline note editing is required

products.name: Plucked!
products.summary: A modeled plucked-string synthesizer.

products.name: Poizone
products.summary: A subtractive synthesizer aimed at accessible sound design and performance controls.

products.name: ReWired
products.summary: A host for compatible ReWire applications and devices.
limitations: It depends on external ReWire compatibility and is not an instrument by itself.
ReWire was discontinued in 2020 and Image-Line support for this deprecated device ended with FL Studio 20.7.

products.name: Sakura
products.summary: A physical-modeling instrument for struck, plucked, bowed, and resonant string timbres.

products.name: Sawer
products.summary: A vintage-inspired subtractive synthesizer.

products.name: SimSynth
products.summary: A classic FL Studio subtractive synthesizer.

products.name: Slicex
products.summary: An advanced loop slicer combining region detection, wave editing, articulation, and triggered playback.
poor_fit_when: simple one-shot playback is enough

products.name: Soundgoodizer
products.summary: A simplified one-control interface to selected Maximus processing presets.
poor_fit_when: precise control or transparent diagnosis is required

products.name: Speech Synthesizer
products.summary: A Windows-only dialog that turns typed text into computerized or vocoder-like vocals and renders the result to a sliced Audio Clip.
limitations: Windows only; it is a dialog rather than a standalone Add Plugin instrument, and PostFader cannot automate its render workflow.

products.name: Spreader
products.summary: A stereo-width processor designed around mono-compatible enhancement.

products.name: SynthMaker
products.summary: A modular environment for building custom generators and effects.
limitations: It is a construction environment; capabilities depend on the graph built inside it.
Legacy, unsupported, 32-bit Windows-only module for projects opened with FL Studio 20.8.4 or older.

products.name: Sytrus
products.summary: A six-operator FM and RM synthesizer with subtractive filters, unison, waveshaping, and extensive modulation.
poor_fit_when: a simple preset player or single-oscillator workflow is preferable

products.name: Toxic Biohazard
products.summary: An FM synthesizer with sequenced modulation and integrated effects.

products.name: Transient Processor
products.summary: A dynamics effect for independently shaping attack and sustain.
poor_fit_when: level-dependent compression rather than envelope shaping is required

products.name: Transistor Bass
products.summary: A subtractive bass synthesizer inspired by classic acid-style hardware.

products.name: Transmitter
products.summary: A processor that separates transient and sustained components for independent treatment.

products.name: Transporter
products.summary: An automatic relooping and retriggering effect.

products.name: Tuner
products.summary: A pitch and tuning display for monophonic instrument signals.

products.name: VFX Sequencer
products.summary: A Patcher-oriented sequencing module that generates and transforms note events.
limitations: It is designed for use inside Patcher rather than as a conventional audio instrument.

products.name: Vintage Chorus
products.summary: A vintage-style chorus modeled after a classic six-voice analog synthesizer chorus character.

products.name: Vintage Phaser
products.summary: A vintage-style phaser modeled after a classic stompbox topology.

products.name: Vocodex
products.summary: An advanced vocoder with detailed band analysis, carrier shaping, and articulation controls.
poor_fit_when: simple pitch correction rather than carrier-modulator synthesis is needed

products.name: Wasp
products.summary: A classic FL Studio subtractive synthesizer.
limitations: Discontinued from FL Studio 20 onward; use a current synthesizer for new projects.

products.name: Wasp XT
products.summary: An expanded version of the Wasp subtractive synthesizer.
limitations: Discontinued from FL Studio 20 onward; use a current synthesizer for new projects.

products.name: Wave Candy
products.summary: A configurable audio-analysis display with waveform, spectrum, level, and stereo visualizations.
limitations: Visual analysis is not a substitute for live audio access, which FL does not expose to PostFader.

products.name: Wave Traveller
products.summary: A sample instrument for drawing travel paths through audio and triggering warped slices.

products.name: Buzz Effect Adapter
products.summary: A legacy adapter for hosting compatible Buzz effects inside older 32-bit FL Studio releases.
limitations: No longer included with FL Studio 12 or later; the old 32-bit workaround is unsupported.

products.name: Fruity NoteBook 2
products.summary: A simple 100-page notepad for song information, lyrics, story text, and production notes.
limitations: It stores project notes; it does not process audio.

products.name: Fruity Voltage Controller
products.summary: A hardware-control utility for sending up to eight channels of control voltage to modular equipment.
limitations: Requires a DC-coupled audio interface; outputs repurposed for control voltage are not available for audio.

products.name: Fruity X-Y-Z Controller
products.summary: An internal controller whose mouse or touch gestures generate X, Y, and Z modulation sources; multitouch pinch can control Z.

products.name: Razer Chroma
products.summary: A visual effect that drives supported Razer Chroma lighting on laptops, keyboards, mice, mousepads, and headsets.
limitations: It requires compatible Razer Chroma hardware and does not process project audio.

products.name: VFX Color Mapper
products.summary: A Patcher event-data filter that routes Piano Roll note colors to as many as sixteen instrument groups.

products.name: VFX Envelope
products.summary: A Patcher controller for applying envelopes to note velocity, pitch, pan, Mod X, and Mod Y event properties.

products.name: VFX Key Mapper
products.summary: A Patcher utility for remapping MIDI note and event data.

products.name: VFX Keyboard Splitter
products.summary: A Patcher utility that divides keyboard or Piano Roll input into as many as sixteen zones with velocity curves and transposition.

products.name: VFX Level Scaler
products.summary: A Patcher event utility for scaling incoming levels within an event-processing chain.

products.name: VFX Script
products.summary: A Patcher module that runs bounded product scripts to transform MIDI notes and automation events in real time.
limitations: An Atlas entry does not expose arbitrary Python execution through PostFader.

products.name: Video Visualizer (ZGameEditor)
products.summary: A real-time music visualizer and video-rendering environment driven by project audio and automation.
limitations: PostFader does not expose FL rendering or project saving, even though the product itself can render video through its UI.
